topic: Expanding Force becomes allAdjacentFoes on Psychic Terrain with a grounded user - the target rewrite AND the spread reduction
written_before: the census probe was written, any engine byte was changed, and any run was made

derived_not_predicted.authority: data/mods/champions/moves.ts carries NO `expandingforce` key - `grep -n expandingforce data/mods/champions/moves.ts` returns nothing. The handler is read whole from mainline data/moves.ts:4944-4965. onModifyMove(move, source, target) { if (this.field.isTerrain('psychicterrain') && source.isGrounded()) { move.target = 'allAdjacentFoes'; } }, and onBasePower is chainModify(1.5) under the SAME two clauses.
derived_not_predicted.the_gate_is_the_users_feet: `source.isGrounded()`. The engine comment at the terrainScaled site says the two members disagree about whose feet matter - Expanding Force the USER's, Rising Voltage the TARGET's - and the authority confirms it for this member.
derived_not_predicted.semi_invulnerable: ABSENT from this handler. Neither clause of expandingforce.onModifyMove nor of its onBasePower mentions isSemiInvulnerable(). The scope's observation that every TERRAIN CONDITION handler pairs isGrounded() with !isSemiInvulnerable() is about the CONDITION's own handlers (onSetStatus/onTryHit/onResidual), not about a MOVE reading the field. So the clause does NOT belong in this gate and adding it would be an over-narrowing invented here.
derived_not_predicted.membership: Legal moves whose onModifyMove rewrites move.target, walked over Dex.forFormat('gen9championsvgc2026regmb').moves.all() filtered `exists && !isNonstandard && tier !== 'Illegal'` and carrier-checked through champions_sim.moveCarriers: TWO. (1) Curse - 124 carriers - rewrites to move.nonGhostTarget / 'randomNormal' on a NON-GHOST or ALLY-AIMED user; not field-conditional, a different shape, NOT in this batch. (2) Expanding Force - 38 carriers - rewrites to 'allAdjacentFoes' under a field condition. Tera Starstorm is mainline's third member and is UNREACHABLE here (Terapagos is not in the regulation). So the field-conditional target-rewrite shape has EXACTLY ONE legal member.
derived_not_predicted.landing_road: LITERAL, per the ROADMAP #92 precedent the scope names. No tag carries a target rewrite - `targetClass.target` is Showdown's STATIC move.target string and tag_dex may not be regenerated in these conditions. A one-entry constant table citing data/moves.ts:4960-4964, exactly as the four terrain base-power constants are typed.

P1_both_halves_asserted_separately: YES, and they are two assertions with two separate failure modes. HALF 1 is a TARGET-COUNT assertion: f2's HP loss goes 0 -> positive. HALF 2 is a DAMAGE assertion on f1 comparing two-live-foes against one-live-foe on the SAME terrain: 148/148 today, and after the fix the two-foe number must be strictly LESS than the one-foe number and land in the x0.75 band. A fix that widened the target list and forgot the reduction passes half 1 and FAILS half 2 by dealing 148 to each of two bodies.

P4_board_parted.I_DISAGREE_WITH_THE_SCOPE_AND_HERE_IS_TH: The scope predicts the pool MOVES on 147 clicks. 147 is a count of REAL HUMAN CLICKS in the 17,381-game STORE. The differential does not replay those clicks - `--steering empirical` DRAWS each action from P(move | species) in data/move-priors.json. So the reachable rate is a product, not a count.
P4_board_parted.the_product: Derived from data/team-pool-frozen: an Expanding Force carrier and a Psychic Terrain setter are BOTH present in the six on either side in 399 of 17,381 games = 2.30%. Over 961 games that is ~22. Both must then be BROUGHT (4 of 6 each side, ~44%) -> ~10. The setter must actually CLICK Psychic Terrain inside the 12-turn cap: its per-decision prior is 0.084 (Meowstic), 0.032 (Meowstic-M-Mega), 0.030 (Reuniclus), 0.024 (Meowstic-F) -> ~26% over the turns it is active -> ~2.6. The carrier must then click Expanding Force inside the 5-turn terrain window (priors 0.030-0.342) -> ~30% -> ~0.8 games. And both foes must still be standing for a second body to exist.
P4_board_parted.point_estimate_in_words: ZERO to ONE game. I predict the pool SITS STILL and I am saying so before the run.
P4_board_parted.the_one_piece_of_direct_evidence_pointin: data/verification/game-differential.punishkinds.json `mid_void.unshared_address_shapes` carries `acc expandingforce [sd only]: 2`, `crit expandingforce [sd only]: 2`, `dmg expandingforce [sd only]: 2` - the AUTHORITY drew accuracy/crit/damage addresses for Expanding Force that medicham2 never drew, in 2 games. That is exactly the second target's draws. But all 9 low-identity games ALSO carry `populationbomb [sd only]: 9`, so those 2 games are unlikely to leave the VOID bucket on this fix alone.
